% SlideMage template name: Research hooks test
% The template of tests/test_research_hooks.py: the hooks of docs/plans/research-theme.md (step F1) switched on with
% values of their own, so the test can find each in the PDF. The background picture is SlideMage's own logo
% (latex/slidemage-logo.pdf, on the framework's search path), not an institution's artwork.
\input{SlideMage_setup}

\renewcommand{\SMFrametitleStyle}{plain}
\renewcommand{\SMFrametitleAlign}{left}
\renewcommand{\SMInstituteLogoPath}{}
\renewcommand{\SMTitleTextColor}{c_primary_dark}
\setlength{\SMFrametitleLeftPadding}{20pt}
\setlength{\SMFrametitleRightPadding}{20pt}

\renewcommand{\SMPageBorder}{on}
\setlength{\SMPageBorderWidth}{0.9pt}
\renewcommand{\SMPageBorderColor}{c_custom_red}
\setlength{\SMPageBorderInsetTop}{12pt}
\setlength{\SMPageBorderInsetLeft}{9pt}
\setlength{\SMPageBorderInsetRight}{11pt}
\renewcommand{\SMPageBorderKinds}{content,title,section}
\setlength{\SMFooterBoxHeight}{14pt}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterBoxColorDefault}{none}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterTextColor}{c_primary_dark}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterTextFont}{\itshape}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterRightEdge}{11pt}

\renewcommand{\SMTitleframeStyle}{plain}
\renewcommand{\SMSectionframeStyle}{plain}
\setlength{\SMTitleframeLogoHeight}{0.9cm}

\SMSetBackground{title}{\SMBackgroundPicture[height=0.8\paperheight, opacity=0.1]{slidemage-logo.pdf}}
\SMSetBackground{section}{\SMBackgroundPicture[height=0.8\paperheight, opacity=0.1]{slidemage-logo.pdf}}
\SMSetBackground{content}{\SMBackgroundPicture[height=2\paperheight, at=current page.north west, opacity=0.1]{slidemage-logo.pdf}}

\input{SlideMage_base}
